name: Beaconbit · Gremlet #48
description:
A little machine with a beacon on its head. It lights the way home for anything lost after dark.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Beaconbit in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
